rules.statement: `horizon_months` is a whole number from 1 to 60. Give exactly one of `minimum_cash` and `minimum_cash_absence`; a `minimum_cash.amount` is not negative.

`assessments` holds exactly one row for each `section` (liquidity_runway, maturity_wall, funding_gap), no section missing and none twice. The maturity_wall row lists in `basis_refs` a ref of the T4.18 maturity_date fact from `cp1_facts`.
Every `basis_refs` entry, in an assessment or in `minimum_cash`, is a `ref` listed in `cp1_facts` of the module context; any other name is refused.

Every analyst text (`text`, `credit_implication` and `limitation` of an assessment, `minimum_cash.rationale`, and the absence `reason` and `follow_up`) is nonblank, has no digit, and contains none of these substrings in any case: refinanc, recommend, buy, sell, overweight, underweight, fulcrum, recovery, covenant breach, covenant test is met, in compliance with, covenant compliance, default will, lme, liability management.
An assessment of category Insufficient Information states a nonblank `limitation`; an assessment of any other category has a null `limitation`.
